mechanism: Both drugs cause metabolic acidosis and electrolyte abnormalities (hypokalemia, hypochloremia); dorzolamide inhibits carbonic anhydrase while furosemide is a loop diuretic, compounding hypokalemia and acid-base disturbances.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (potassium, chloride, bicarbonate) and acid-base status regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing diuretic; assess for signs of metabolic acidosis.
